title: auth.html forwards an unvalidated type parameter into the app deep link
description: The email-confirmation handoff page reads token_hash and type from its query string and builds pullupmaster://login?token_hash=...&type=... with both values URL-encoded. The page does not restrict type to the expected set (signup, magiclink, recovery, email_change). Impact depends on how the mobile app consumes type, which is outside this repository.
claimed_root_cause: type is taken from location.search with a default of signup and no allowlist before being handed to the app.

trace.description: token_hash read from the query string.
type read from the query string, default signup, no allowlist.
Both values are encodeURIComponent-encoded into the custom-scheme URL and navigated to.

evidence.description: Target scheme and host are fixed, values are encoded, so the page itself has no injection or open redirect.

blockers: The app's handler for pullupmaster://login is not in this repository.
A token_hash is single-use and bound to a Supabase user, so an attacker needs a valid token for their own account at minimum.

validation_plan.local: In the app repo, confirm the login deep-link handler allowlists type before calling verifyOtp and ignores unknown values.
validation_plan.deployment: Owner checks the Supabase email templates only ever emit the expected type values.

title: indexnow.yml interpolates a github.event value into a shell command
description: The workflow runs bash scripts/indexnow.sh --changed "${{ github.event.before }}" on push to main.
claimed_root_cause: Actions expression expanded inline in run script.

trace.description: Triggers only on pushes to main.
github.event.before expanded into the command line.

evidence.description: github.event.before is a 40-hex commit SHA generated by GitHub, not attacker-chosen text. Trigger is push, not pull_request_target or issue events, and no secrets are used.

reason: The interpolated value is a GitHub-generated SHA and the trigger requires write access to main. No boundary is crossed.

title: site.js assigns data-msg to innerHTML
description: The feedback demo copies a button's data-msg attribute into result.innerHTML.
claimed_root_cause: HTML sink fed from a DOM attribute.

trace.description: Reads dataset.msg of a clicked button.

evidence.description: The attribute values are authored static HTML in the repo. No URL, storage or network input reaches them.

reason: No lower-trust principal controls data-msg. Static site, no user-generated content, no query-string or storage reads feed the attribute. Self-authored content, not a boundary crossing.
